title: Being locally of finite presentation descends along fpqc coverings (Stacks 02KY)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{g_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For $i\in I$ let $f_i:X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ be the base change of $f$ along $g_i$, the second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f_i$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] for every $i\in I$, then $f$ is locally of finite presentation.
